OmniControl Suite v7.8.0 — Intelligent Core SMT/Hyper-Threading Parking on Battery:
- SMT Core Parking Engine: Programmatically parks secondary logical hyper-threads on battery power (CPMINCORES 50), allowing 6 physical cores to run at full IPC while secondary threads enter C6 deep sleep.
- 15%–20% CPU Package Power Reduction: Drastically reduces static core leakage current on battery while stabilizing 1% low frame times.
- Micro-Thread Priority Gating: Demotes anti-cheat worker threads to BelowNormal and elevates main game to High.
- Direct DWM Composition Bypass (DirectFlip & Flip Queue = 1).
- Dynamic Power Budget Ratio Optimizer (CPU vs GPU Rebalancing).
- Resolution Scale & FSR/NIS Automator.
- Kernel DPC Latency Watchdog & audiodg.exe Pro-Audio Lock.
